verdict.rationale: Muse documents its own capabilities that touch parts of this story. It keeps a complete audit trail and activity log of everything it has done and plans to do. A Goals tab lets users inspect and interact with ongoing scheduled tasks. Its VM, which holds the tools and files Muse builds, is backed up continuously so it can be restored, which gives a coarse rollback path. However, nothing documents versioning or diffing of the automations themselves, or rolling back an individual automation. missing for 10: explicit versioning/history of automations or goals, per-automation rollback (beyond whole-VM restore), review of automation definitions or changes before they take effect, independent or hands-on corroboration.
